num_retailers: <int> Number of retailers to be served by the supplier.
time_horizon: <int> Number of discrete periods over which deliveries can be scheduled.

supplier.id: <int> Identifier for the supplier node in the distance matrix.
supplier.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of the supplier location.
supplier.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of the supplier location.
supplier.starting_inventory: <int> Amount of product available at the supplier at the beginning of the planning horizon.
supplier.production_rate: <int> Quantity of product produced at the supplier in each period.
supplier.inventory_cost: <float> Per-unit cost of holding one unit of product at the supplier for one period.

retailers.id: <int> Identifier for this retailer node in the distance matrix.
retailers.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of this retailer's location.
retailers.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of this retailer's location.
retailers.demand: <int> Quantity of product consumed by this retailer in each period.
retailers.max_inventory: <int> Maximum amount of product this retailer can store at any time.
retailers.starting_inventory: <int> Amount of product available at this retailer at the beginning of the planning horizon.
retailers.inventory_cost: <float> Per-unit cost of holding one unit of product at this retailer for one period.

vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum total quantity of product the delivery vehicle can carry in a single period.
distance_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [num_retailers+1][num_retailers+1]> Symmetric transportation cost between each pair of locations, where row and column 0 is the supplier and rows and columns 1 through num_retailers are the retailers.
